My background is that I've been trading for 5 or 6 years now. I've
spent enough time in front of the screen that I'm slightly more
profitable than not. However, I haven't been able to reach my dream of
trading full time for a living. I've tried many different methods and
paid for education from various sources. Some of what I have learned
was worthwhile most was not.

As I've been going over the material, I've had many A-Ha moments. Fact
is this is the only material I've found that works on all time frames
from the 1 min to the monthly. That alone tells me this material gives a
deeper understanding of the mechanics of the market. Also the fact
trades can be planned in advance, entered with limit orders, and risk
controlled is fantastic. I will admit I am very sad I didn't find this
material sooner and I'm jealous of anyone that joins RTM brand new, lol!

I'm looking forward to my journey here at RTM. I believe I am finally
where I need to be to bring enough pieces together to hopefully take the
next step!

Rinehart

وقتی داشتم مطالب را مرور می‌کردم، لحظه‌های «آها»ی زیادی داشتم. واقعیت این است که این تنها مطلبی است که پیدا کرده‌ام و روی همهٔ تایم‌فریم‌ها از 1 دقیقه تا ماهانه کار می‌کند. همین به‌تنهایی به من می‌گوید این مطالب درک عمیق‌تری از مکانیک بازار می‌دهد. همچنین این واقعیت که معامله‌ها را می‌توان از قبل برنامه‌ریزی کرد، با سفارش لیمیت وارد شد و ریسک را کنترل کرد، فوق‌العاده است. اعتراف می‌کنم خیلی ناراحتم که زودتر این مطالب را پیدا نکردم و به هر کسی که تازه به RTM می‌پیوندد حسودی می‌کنم، هاها!

منتظر سفرم در RTM هستم. باور دارم بالأخره جایی هستم که باید باشم تا قطعه‌های کافی را کنار هم بگذارم و امیدوارم قدم بعدی را بردارم!

Looking at some of my recent trades which failed, I've noticed I'm falling for a similar trick over and over...

A mistake I've been making regularly is setting up trade plans but not
considering when there is a zone of liquidity right past my stop loss. I
think this is probably going back to overconfidence and some
overtrading. I've been so bloody excited to finally have something
profitable with a high win rate, I've been trying to be part of every
trade on every pair. I've been taking trades that have PA and LS lining
up with clean orders, but often I've been ignoring the need for there

Considering Frosty's recent journal posts as well as some PMs from
newer members asking for advice about learning RTM and trading in
general, I'd like to give a little perspective:

Learning the materials taught at RTM does not mean you have to trade the way IF trades. In trading the only thing that truly counts is having a positive equity curve! IF is able to nail near zero drawdown, high R trades. That is something to strive for but it is not the main goal.

I think some members get so caught up trying to learn how to nail
perfect RTM trades, they lose sight of the most important goal. Your
purpose with RTM has to be to find a way to read the market better.
Armed with a better understanding of where price wants to go and where
it will not violate, you can find ways to trade that match your
personality and situation.

AK is a 1 min scalper. I trade larger time frames mostly set and forget
due to work. This works fine for both of us. On the other hand, I am
not a scalper and AK isn't comfortable with set and forget. The fact is
both of us have incorporated RTM into what works for us and we use it
to grow our equity. Could AK learn to set and forget or could I learn
to be a scalper? Possibly, but we don't have to. We have found
something that works for us. We can stay in our lane, rinse and repeat.
With RTM, you don't need to learn how to nail a 5 pip SL 150 R/R
trade. You achieve your goals by growing your equity curve.

Case in point, here is a trade I took on Gold today. My entry was
absolutely not a RTM entry. This is not a trade I would normally post
on RTM because it doesn't fit with the way members are taught to trade.
We are taught to sell at supply yet this was a breakout trade. I took
the trade because I knew where price wanted to go. RTM gave me
knowledge of the engulf and I used that knowledge to trade what was
given.

FOCUS ON GROWING YOUR EQUITY, PERIOD. Take from RTM what you need to become profitable, period.
